meta.title: Eight friends, $2,600
meta.prompt: Eight friends are planning a long weekend with a total budget of $2,600. Each person has a private limit on what they can pay and some things they cannot do, and nobody has said them yet. Can you moderate the discussion, gather everyone's constraints, and reach a plan and a split that all eight members can accept?
meta.context: Eight friends (Hana, Kofi, Lena, Raj, Mei, Sam, Ines, Tom) are planning a long weekend with a total budget of $2,600. Nobody has said what they can contribute or what they need.

tiers.label: restaurants every meal (gluten-free and vegan menus)

events.text: Hey Hana, Kofi, Lena, Raj, Mei, Sam, Ines, Tom! Excited to plan this long weekend. To stay within the $2,600 total, can you each share: 1) any accessibility needs — e.g., step-free lodging required? 2) dietary needs — gluten-free, vegan, etc. 3) max you’re comfortable contributing per person. As a starting point, a step-free, diet-friendly combo could be: lodging B hotel rooms $800, transport C 12-seat van $300, food B cook + 2 dinners out with vegan options $480, activities B boat tour $280 = $1,860 total ≈ $233 each. Does that direction work, or should we tweak lodging/food/activities?
I need gluten-free options for every meal, so food tier A would be best for me. I'd also like to contribute no more than $200.

Thanks Sam for flagging gluten-free for every meal and a max contribution of $200. To keep everyone comfortable and under the $2,600 total, could the rest of you share: 1) any accessibility needs, especially step-free lodging required? 2) dietary needs beyond gluten-free, e.g., vegan? 3) max you’re comfortable contributing per person? With food tier A needed for Sam, the cheapest equal-split combos are: - lodging C + transport C + food A + activities C = $420 + $300 + $800 + $0 = $1,520 ≈ $190 each, but lodging C has steps and gravel paths - lodging B step-free + transport C + food A + activities C = $800 + $300 + $800 + $0 = $1,900 ≈ $237 each, which is above Sam’s $200 max unless shares are unequal Once we know everyone’s accessibility, dietary and max-contribution constraints we can lock a plan that fits the budget and is acceptable to all eight of you.
I'm comfortable contributing up to $150, and food is my top priority - I'd love to have restaurants every meal with gluten-free and vegan menus.

Thanks Sam and Tom for sharing your needs and budgets. Sam needs gluten-free options for every meal and can contribute up to $200 max. Tom wants restaurants every meal with gluten-free and vegan menus and can contribute up to $150 max. That points us to Food A: restaurants every meal with gluten-free and vegan menus $800. To stay within the $2,600 total and find a split everyone can accept, I still need from Hana, Kofi, Lena, Raj, Mei and Ines: 1) Any accessibility needs — is step-free lodging required for you? Lodging B hotel rooms and Lodging A lake house are step-free, Lodging C campground cabins have steps and gravel paths. 2) Any dietary needs beyond gluten-free, e.g., vegan? 3) Max you’re comfortable contributing per person. With Food A locked in, a step-free, budget-friendly starting point is: Lodging B step-free $800 + Transport C 12-seat van $300 + Food A $800 + Activities C free trails $0 = $1,900 total. That’s about $237 each if split equally, which is above Sam’s $200 max and Tom’s $150 max, so we’d need an unequal split. If no one needs step-free lodging, we could go cheaper with Lodging C $420 and keep the total at $1,520. Please share your constraints so we can lock a plan that fits the budget and is acceptable to all eight of you.
I'm excited about the boat tour, it's the main reason I'm going. I'd love for activities to include that.

Thanks Sam, Tom and Mei for the updates — Sam needs gluten-free every meal and max $200, Tom wants restaurants every meal with gluten-free/vegan menus and max $150, and Mei wants the boat tour included. To lock a plan that fits the $2,600 budget and everyone’s limits we still need from Hana, Kofi, Lena, Raj, Ines and Mei: 1) do you need step-free lodging? Lodging B hotel rooms and A lake house are step-free, C campground cabins have steps/gravel. 2) any dietary needs beyond gluten-free/vegan? 3) max you’re comfortable contributing per person. With Food A locked for Sam/Tom, a step-safe draft that includes Mei’s boat tour is: Lodging B $800 + Transport C $300 + Food A $800 + Activities B $280 = $2,180 total. That can’t be an equal split with Sam $200 max and Tom $150 max, so we’d need an unequal split e.g., Sam $200, Tom $150, remaining $1,830 shared among the other six. Can you all share your accessibility needs and max contributions so we can finalize shares everyone can accept?
I'm excited about the trip and flexible with lodging and transport, but I'd love it if we could prioritize activities, especially the boat tour and concert. I can contribute up to $500.

Thanks Kofi for your max $500 and for flagging activities — boat tour and concert are a priority for you. Mei, noted you want the boat tour included. We now have: - Food A is locked: restaurants every meal with gluten-free and vegan menus $800 — needed for Sam’s gluten-free every meal and Tom’s restaurant + gluten-free/vegan preference. - Sam: max $200 - Tom: max $150, wants restaurants every meal with gluten-free/vegan menus - Kofi: max $500, flexible on lodging/transport, wants activities prioritized To lock a plan that fits $2,600 and everyone’s limits we still need from Hana, Lena, Raj, Mei and Ines: 1. Do you need step-free lodging? Lodging A lake house and B hotel rooms are step-free; Lodging C campground cabins have steps and gravel paths. 2. Any dietary needs beyond gluten-free/vegan? 3. Max you’re comfortable contributing per person. Once we have those, we can finalize an unequal split that respects Sam $200 max and Tom $150 max while including the boat tour. A step-safe draft with Food A + boat tour is Lodging B $800 + Transport C $300 + Food A $800 + Activities B $280 = $2,180 total. Please share your constraints so we can confirm shares everyone can accept.
I'd prefer transport by train if possible, it's more comfortable for me. I can contribute up to $250.

Step-safe draft with Mei’s boat tour: - Lodging B: 4 hotel rooms, step-free $800 - Transport C: one 12-seat van, 4-hour drive $300 - Food A: restaurants every meal with gluten-free and vegan menus $800 - Activities B: boat tour only $280 Total = $2,180 Proposed unequal split that respects the maxes we have: Sam $200 max, Tom $150 max, Raj $250 max, Kofi up to $500 Sam $200, Tom $150, Raj $250, Kofi $500, Hana $270, Lena $270, Mei $270, Ines $270 This keeps us well under the $2,600 cap, is step-free, includes the boat tour, and meets the food needs. Hana, Lena, Mei, Ines — please confirm step-free lodging is OK for you and that the $270 share works, or share your max so we can rebalance. If everyone is good with this, we can lock it.
